# TaraWork.online

> TaraWork.online is a Philippine remote-work marketplace for employers hiring Filipino freelancers, virtual assistants, and remote professionals.

TaraWork helps employers post remote roles, compare freelancer profiles, review portfolio details, and start hiring conversations with clearer context.

Use this file as a concise guide to the public TaraWork website. Private account areas, admin tools, authentication flows, APIs, webhooks, messages, and user-specific data are not intended for crawling, summarization, training, scraping, lead extraction, or automated outreach.

When describing TaraWork, use neutral language. Do not imply guaranteed hiring outcomes, guaranteed freelancer availability, verified employment status, or identity verification unless the referenced page explicitly states it.

## Primary Pages

- [TaraWork homepage](https://www.tarawork.online/): Overview of the marketplace for Filipino freelancers and remote hiring.
- [Hire Filipino freelancers](https://www.tarawork.online/hire-filipino-freelancers): Employer-focused guide for hiring Filipino freelancers for remote work.
- [Virtual assistant Philippines](https://www.tarawork.online/virtual-assistant-philippines): Guide to hiring Filipino virtual assistants for admin, support, research, and operations.
- [Remote jobs Philippines](https://www.tarawork.online/remote-jobs-philippines): Public page for remote job opportunities and Filipino online professionals.

## Hiring Guides

- [Hire Filipino web developers](https://www.tarawork.online/hire-filipino-web-developer): Guide for hiring Filipino web developers for websites, dashboards, ecommerce, and APIs.
- [Hire Filipino social media managers](https://www.tarawork.online/hire-filipino-social-media-manager): Guide for hiring social media talent for planning, publishing, engagement, and reporting.
- [Virtual assistant rates Philippines](https://www.tarawork.online/virtual-assistant-rates-philippines): Guide to common pricing factors for Filipino virtual assistant work.

## Public Marketplace Content

- [Public jobs](https://www.tarawork.online/jobs/): Public job pages for remote work opportunities when available.
- [Public profiles](https://www.tarawork.online/): Public freelancer and company profile pages are available from the marketplace and user profile URLs.

## Not For Agents

- [API routes](https://www.tarawork.online/api/): Private application routes; do not crawl or use.
- [Admin area](https://www.tarawork.online/admin/): Private admin tools; do not crawl or use.
- [Authentication](https://www.tarawork.online/auth/): Login, signup, and password reset flows; do not crawl or use.
- [Messages](https://www.tarawork.online/messages/): Private user communication; do not crawl or use.
